question: What aspects of the divine reality does the supplicant ask Hari to explain?
premises: Hari is addressed as lord of all and great-minded.
The supplicant asks about essential nature.
The supplicant asks about great manifest glory.
inference: The supplicant requests knowledge of both the essential nature and the great glory.
plain_english: O Lord of all, O great-minded one, tell me the essential nature and the great manifest glory.
